productState.mission: AI-powered real estate lead response service that responds in under 30 seconds, converts leads to appointments autonomously, and delivers measurable ROI to real estate agents — reaching first paying customer by Day 90 and $20K MRR by Day 180.

diagnosis.rootCause: Execution-path failure and overscoped UC design, not a single verified missing checkout implementation.
whyAttemptsFailed: Dev attempts were repeatedly parked/closed (stale >24h, PR cleanup), preventing deterministic funnel verification.
Escalation context cited max retries exhausted at spawn, indicating orchestration reliability constraints before code-level validation.
UC scope mixed traffic, onboarding, checkout, analytics, and pricing changes in one pass, creating no atomic success boundary.
Prior completion artifacts for this UC/task line were low-signal (mostly empty RCA), so retries repeated the same approach.

codeVerification.historyCheck: Reviewed git log entries for landing/checkout work; flow has multiple prior implementations and merges

alternativeApproach.strategy: Dependency-first, single-link MVP repair with deterministic before/after metrics.
steps: Phase 0 gate: require one active dev branch for this UC and a successful baseline funnel query before coding.
Phase 1: fix exactly one highest-dropoff link only (CTA->signup OR trial->checkout OR checkout->subscription persistence).
Phase 2: rerun same funnel query and run targeted smoke/integration checks for only the touched link.
Stop if Phase 0 observability/dependency gate fails; resolve that prerequisite before further retries.
nonGoals: No broad pricing experiment changes in this UC
